acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was performed with the resolution of the Orbitrap set to 30,000, with a fill time of 94 ms and a limitation of 1 × 105 ions.
cleavage_agent: Trypsin digestion and peptide purification was performed using the S-Trap mini column (Protifi) following the manufacturer's instructions
collision_energy: A normalized collision energy of 34 was applied.
fractionation_method: Off-line high pH reverse phase fractionation was carried out on an Agilent 1200 Infinity high-performance liquid chromatography system, equipped with a Gemini C18 column

instrument.value: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer
instrument.evidence: An UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano LC system (Dionex) equipped with an μ-Precolumn (C18 PepMap 100, 5μm, 300 μm i.d. × 5 mm, 100 Å) and an analytical column (nanoEase M/Z HSS T3 column 75 µm × 250 mm C18, 1.8 μm, 100 Å, Waters) was coupled directly to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)

ionization_type: The eluates were infused on-line to TripleTOF 5600 System with NanoSpray III source and heated interface (SCIEX) and ionized in an electrospray ionization-positive mode.
labeling: For each sample, 20 μg of peptides were labeled with TMT Isobaric Label Reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
mass_analyzer: Full mass scan was acquired with mass range 375–1500 m/z in profile mode in the Orbitrap with resolution of 120,000.

ptm.value: Carbamidomethyl (C), TMT16 (K), Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M), TMT10 (N-term), TMT16 (N-term)
ptm.evidence: The following modifications were included into the search parameters: Carbamidomethyl (C) and TMT16 (K) as fixed modifications, Acetyl (Protein N-term), Oxidation (M) and TMT10 or TMT16 (N-term) as variable modifications.
